next_starting_point.design_finding: E8a aggregates a subtype position-weighted; the operator takes an unweighted mean over items. On unequal-length items these differ by ~0.027, ~300x the 8.195e-05 decision margin. A naive score comparison would have read as catastrophic drift, so the paired check is per-item.

process_note: 'my intended next decision is GO' is NOT executable permission. An explicit imperative GO is required, and it covers the workload named - not new paid-path infrastructure written to carry it, which is its own review. The measurement launch of 2026-08-19 did have a GO in the immediately preceding message, but the session machinery executing it was written and launched in the same session without review, and that is where it failed.
